newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks traded mix in slower trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks traded mix in slower trade.

text.p: Croatian shares closed mixed on Thursday, falling behind the record turnover and volumes of the previous day.
* Out of 19 active stocks eight were up, seven down and four remained flat.
* Volume was more than halved to 11,768 shares, and so was the turnover at 10 million kuna.

* Biggest gainer was the 2-issue of the new top listing Varazdinska Banka, which closed at 1,400 kuna, gaining 510 kuna since it was last traded last November, but on a symbolic volume of eight shares.
* Biggest loser, shipper Atlantska Plovidba lost 15 kuna, closing at 120 on 50 shares traded.
* The most active stock was Zagrebacka Banka ordinary share on volume of 3,507.
